questiontext.text:
Which of the following statements represents an exponential function? Select all that apply.

[[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

[[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Let's evaluate each statement:

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

A population of bacteria decreases by a factor of \(\displaystyle \frac{1}{{@element@}} \) every \(24\) hours.

This represents an exponential decay function because the population is reduced by a constant multiplicative factor (\(\displaystyle \frac{1}{{@element@}} \)) over regular time intervals (every \(24\) hours).

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

The value of a car decreases by \(10\%\) every year.

This represents an exponential decay function because the car's value is reduced by a constant percentage (\(10\%\)) every year. The factor \(b\) in this case is \(0.90\) (since \(100\% - 10\% = 90\%\)).

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

The number of attendees at a conference doubles every year.

This represents an exponential growth function because the number of attendees increases by a constant multiplicative factor (doubles, or \(b = 2\)) each year.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(4, ta_index)" ]]

The intensity of a radioactive substance decreases by half every \(10\) years.

This represents an exponential decay function because the intensity decreases by a constant multiplicative factor (\(\displaystyle \frac{1}{2}\)) over regular time intervals (every \(10\) years).

[[/ if ]]
